title: Jeremiah
author: Jeremiah son of Hilkiah.
date: Late seventh to early sixth century B.C.
audience: Judah before and during the fall of Jerusalem.
historicalSetting: Jeremiah warns of judgment, calls for repentance, and promises a new covenant.
keyVerse: Jeremiah 31:31 — "I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel."
christFocus: Jeremiah points to Christ through the promised new covenant, fulfilled through Jesus' blood and the inward work of God in His people.
outline: Judah's sin and coming judgment — Jeremiah 1-29
